facts.text: Dubrillion was a planet in the Dubrillion system with beautiful oceans and lush, green continents, a sky dotted with fluffy, white clouds.

evidence.quote: Dubrillion was a planet in the Dubrillion system with beautiful oceans and lush, green continents, a sky dotted with fluffy, white clouds.

facts.text: Dubrillion would duly become a world of the Galactic Empire after the Clone Wars; when that government fell, entrepreneur Lando Calrissian would take-over the planet and serve as its administrator.

evidence.quote: Dubrillion would duly become a world of the Galactic Empire after the Clone Wars; when that government fell, entrepreneur Lando Calrissian would take-over the planet and serve as its administrator.

facts.text: There was an asteroid belt situated near the planet, which was used by Calrissian as the basis for a large operation some time after the Empire's end.

evidence.quote: There was an asteroid belt situated near the planet, which was used by Calrissian as the basis for a large operation some time after the Empire's end.

facts.text: In addition, Dubrillion hosted many hotels and apartments with luxury suites, located in its massive high-rise cities.

evidence.quote: In addition, Dubrillion hosted many hotels and apartments with luxury suites, located in its massive high-rise cities.

facts.text: Following the Yuuzhan Vong's defeat, Dubrillion later became a world of the Fel Empire.

evidence.quote: Following the Yuuzhan Vong's defeat, Dubrillion later became a world of the Fel Empire.

facts.text: In the decades before the Great Galactic War, the planet was ruled by the Drayen family, a dynasty of war heroes who took their position as Dubrillion's rulers through treachery.

evidence.quote: In the decades before the Great Galactic War, the planet was ruled by the Drayen family, a dynasty of war heroes who took their position as Dubrillion's rulers through treachery.

facts.text: Dubrillion was eventually sacked by Empress Vaylin's Eternal Fleet during the revolt against the Eternal Empire.

facts.text: With the onset of the Clone Wars, Dubrillion was located within Separatist space, though its resident sector of space was contested between both the CIS and the Galactic Republic.

evidence.quote: With the onset of the Clone Wars, Dubrillion was located within Separatist space, though its resident sector of space was contested between both the CIS and the Galactic Republic.

facts.text: Following the deaths of the Separatist Council members on Mustafar, and the end of the war, the planet fell to the rule of the Galactic Empire.

evidence.quote: Following the deaths of the Separatist Council members on Mustafar, and the end of the war, the planet fell to the rule of the Galactic Empire.

facts.text: The world hosted a factory and testing facility for new weapons in the midst of the Dubrillion Ocean, including a prototype laser for the second Death Star.

evidence.quote: The world hosted a factory and testing facility for new weapons in the midst of the Dubrillion Ocean, including a prototype laser for the second Death Star.

facts.text: It was destroyed in 3 ABY by Rogue Squadron, with the help of defected Imperial General Crix Madine, after several Rebel ships passing the planet were destroyed by a beam fired from Dubrillion.
